race.description: Bowen Cup - Sat 10th October Mdn Hcp
race.comment: QUEEN OF RUSSIA (6) has not raced since her debut back on April 11 when she finished ninth over 1250m at Newcastle. Will find this assignment much easier and is capable of sharp improvement. KNIGHTS (4) is back from a spell of 11 weeks. Closed last prep with a fifth over 1000m at Oak Park. Gets 2kg off from the favourable draw and should be tough to beat. BELINDA'S RUBI (9) was prominent at the turn and finished third last start over 1000m at Townsville, beaten 0.7 lengths. Ideally placed and is sure to give this a mighty shake. TOI TOI (10) finished second last time over 1000m at Townsville when resuming from a spell, beaten 0.6 lengths. Strips fitter now and has the class to take this out.
